paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: Training loss curves for the post-training setting.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the training loss curves for different models during post-training. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, with a linear scale ranging from 95000 to 125000, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 5000. The y-axis represents the loss, with a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 3.0, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains four lines: a magenta line representing SepLLM (n=64, larger lr) with no markers and a solid style, starting at approximately 2.95 and decreasing to 2.2; a blue line representing SepLLM (n=128) with no markers and a solid style, starting at approximately 2.9 and decreasing to 2.2; an orange line representing SepLLM (n=64) with no markers and a solid style, starting at approximately 2.85 and decreasing to 2.2; and a red dashed line representing Vanilla before post-training, remaining steady at 2.35.
